title: Condensed Leaf Litter Armour and Tools
description: Ever wanted more leaf litter? This mod adds 3 different stages of leaf litter items, each stage gets stronger in every way!
body:
Ever wanted more leaf litter? Well for some reason this mod adds it! This mod adds 3 different stages of leaf litter items, each stage gets stronger in every way! 

You can also smelt the Condensed Leaf Litter Blocks and Items (tools and armor excluded) for a great fuel source!
